title: WYNONNA JUDD – The Hard Truth Tour
seo_title: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour in Springfield, MO
description: Wynonna Judd performs live country music on The Hard Truth Tour, featuring her powerful voice and some of her most personal songs. She first rose to fame with her mother, Naomi, as one half of The Judds, which scored eight consecutive No. 1 hits before her solo career. The concert is Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
